detections.evidence_quote: what's the right amount of shrooms to take when you go and see Joey Coco Diaz?
detections.summary: A caller jokingly asks the right dose of psilocybin mushrooms for a comedy show and says he took an eighth.

detections.evidence_quote: when you're on mushrooms, you want to see something natural
detections.summary: Host reacts to the caller attending the show on mushrooms, says he couldn't take any himself, and muses that on mushrooms you want to see something natural.
